issues.finding: Part(c) asks gradient12 and claims x=3,y=8. Exact derivative there is24. Its explanation u(u²+1)²=2 then u=1 is false (left equals4).
issues.action: Simplest coherent repair: ask gradient24, change equation to u(u²+1)²=4, keep x=3,y=8 and monotonic uniqueness proof. Alternatively genuinely solve different gradient target with permitted numerical-method instructions.

issues.finding: Exact same function x ln x−x, domain, derivative ln x and stationary point(1,−1) as deployed v4 P3-C06-R12. New positive-root/root-count tasks are additions, but core stem and first two results repeat oldbank.
issues.action: Replace by a substantially different conditional/parameter or composed-log problem with genuinely different proof target rather than append a part to the old item.

issues.finding: New (1−sinx)/cosx with derivative −1/(1+sinx) is reflection/sign counterpart of old P3-C06-R27 (1+sinx)/cosx, derivative1/(1−sinx). Old tangent at0 is y=x+1; new normal at0 also y=x+1. Overall proof/point workflow remains extremely close.
issues.action: Change relationship/target materially, e.g compare two reciprocal curves or derive a shared-gradient/normal condition at a nontrivial parameter, within scope; avoid only signflip plus tangent-to-normal swap.

issues.finding: New ln x/x² and old P3-C06-R02 ln x/x have same derivative→stationary max workflow. Denominator exponent is numerical change; added tangent part is routine. This risks the user's explicit number-only prohibition.
issues.action: Strengthen through a substantively different condition or proof target (parameter reconstruction, gradient extremum or inverse/area connection), not simply changing exponent1 to2.

issues.finding: Both models use t and request times/rates, but stem does not name time unit. Answers cannot supply physically named units consistently. C06R25 uses vague per time unit.
issues.action: State e.g t measured in days/hours, and use matching units in all answer rates/time.

issues.finding: Trigonometric figure axis text uses approximate decimal endpoints such as3.1 and6.3 instead of π and2π. Mathematically approximate but less exam-like and can obscure exact boundary.
issues.action: Use exact π fraction ticklabels on trig plots. Delete bottom asset-production boilerplate from figure.
